hero.title: Dias Yermek
hero.subtitle: Middle Frontend & Mobile Developer.
hero.description: I build production web and mobile products with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Flutter. Recently at BeyimTech (EdTech, Astana Hub)—AI learning platforms, analytics for 20+ schools, and App Store releases. Open to frontend and mobile roles.

about.title: About Me
about.text1: I'm Dias, a software engineer from Astana, Kazakhstan. I've been building for the web since high school; in my first year at university I shipped my first site and realized I love turning ideas into clear, reliable interfaces.
about.text2: I've worked across EdTech, FoodTech, GovTech, and Blockchain SaaS. I led mobile recovery and shipping at BeyimTech (Next.js, Flutter, Riverpod), built the OpenGov.kz frontend at QB Solutions, delivered contract UI and document flows at TrustMe (1.5M+ users), and developed a Flutter app at Stolovka. I hold a Bachelor's in Software Engineering from Astana IT University (2025).

beyimTech.title: MIDDLE FRONTEND & MOBILE DEVELOPER
beyimTech.subtitle: BeyimTech · EdTech Startup · Astana Hub
beyimTech.info: Built AI-powered educational products with Next.js 14, React 18, and TypeScript—including Lexical editors and next-intl. Led full mobile app recovery: Flutter & Riverpod refactor, AD auth, and AI chatbot for production launch. Shipped analytics dashboards for 20+ schools (RTK Query) and a custom telemetry system for real-time user behavior. Owned iOS/Android deployment (App Store & Google Play) and in-app update flows.

trustme.title: MARKUP DEVELOPER (CONTRACT)
trustme.subtitle: TrustMe · Blockchain SaaS · Remote
trustme.info: Developed and optimized smart-contract templates for a platform serving 1.5M+ users and 3,000+ companies. Integrated REST APIs for legally binding workflows (SMS, digital signatures). Built frontend logic for blockchain authentication and document verification; reusable UI components for the TrustContract ecosystem.

qb-solutions.title: FRONTEND DEVELOPER (INTERNSHIP)
qb-solutions.subtitle: QB Solutions · Remote
qb-solutions.info: Engineered the OpenGov.kz web platform frontend from scratch with Next.js and React—production deployment, UI/UX for news and project catalogs, full i18n, and responsive layouts. Worked in Agile with GitHub for version control and milestones.

stolovka.title: MOBILE DEVELOPER (INTERNSHIP)
stolovka.subtitle: Stolovka · FoodTech Startup · Remote
stolovka.info: Built a near-production Flutter app: catalog, cart, profile, and auth from Figma designs. Implemented in-app updates via Firebase Remote Config and distribution through Firebase App Distribution for rapid team testing.

astana-it.title: BACHELOR OF SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
astana-it.subtitle: Astana IT University · Astana, Kazakhstan
astana-it.info: Graduated with a Bachelor's in Software Engineering. Foundation in algorithms, software design, and modern web technologies that shaped my path into frontend and mobile development.

finance-app.title: Finance Management Application
finance-app.description: Full-stack mobile app for intelligent finance tracking—React Native (Expo) client and FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL. OpenAI-powered assistant analyzes spending and gives personalized advice; interactive charts for budgets and limits; REST API with OpenAPI documentation.

opengov.title: OpenGov.kz
opengov.description: Built the entire OpenGov.kz frontend during my QB Solutions internship—Next.js, React, i18n, and responsive production deployment for transparent public data and citizen–government communication.

berik-web.title: Berik Zhunusbek
berik-web.description: A personal website created for sculptor, artist, actor, and CG specialist Berik Zhunusbek. The site presents his biography, portfolio of works, and career highlights, designed as a clean and accessible digital presence.

evently.title: Evently
evently.description: A streamlined platform for modern event planning featuring QR invitations, voting on time slots, customizable events, and seamless RSVPs.

kaz-data.title: Kaz-data Solutions
kaz-data.description: A streamlined platform for searching and booking events across Kazakhstan, similar to Ticketon.

flower-shop.title: IT-Flower Shop
flower-shop.description: A web-based flower shop platform for browsing, selecting, and purchasing floral arrangements online.

aitu-calc.title: AITU Grade Calculator
aitu-calc.description: A Python app with a CustomTkinter interface for calculating final grades and checking scholarship eligibility.

queuems.title: QueueMS
queuems.description: A microservices-based queue management system built with Go, featuring client, notification, and queue services for efficient task handling.

params-retrieval.title: Parameters Retrieval
params-retrieval.description: The "Daelijek Parameters Retrieval" program is a Python application designed to retrieve various system parameters and information using a graphical user interface (GUI).

nwa.title: NWA
nwa.description: A simple website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript about the rap group N.W.A, featuring their history and members.

book-review.title: Book Review
book-review.description: A simple program for browsing detailed book information across different categories.

voice-assistant.title: Voice Assistant
voice-assistant.description: A Python-based voice assistant that executes simple commands activated by speech.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.text: Open to full-time, contract, and freelance frontend/mobile work. Fastest on Telegram—usually reply within 24 hours. Whether it's hiring, a project, or just saying hi, I'd love to hear from you.
